# Lowbridge: project rules for agents

<!-- DEEPINIT:START · generated by DeepInit 0.7.2 · run deepinit-20261021T205954Z · 2026-10-21. Regenerated by `deep-init`; edit outside these markers. -->
## Architecture at a glance (DeepInit)

Browser incremental, plain DOM, no runtime deps. One-way graph: `content → engine ← persistence ← main → ui`; no cycles.

| Component | Files | Role |
|---|---|---|
| engine | `src/engine.ts`, `src/expression.ts`, `src/types.ts` | `GameEngine`: all rules, time, combat, tooltips |
| content | `src/data/{shared,opening,ridge}.json`, `src/content.ts` | 122 declarative records (29/34/59), concatenated in that order |
| persistence | `src/persistence.ts` | Save v6 sparse delta in IndexedDB (`current` + `backup`) |
| ui | `src/main.ts`, `src/ui.ts`, `src/style.css`, `index.html` | Boot, Web Lock, ticker, DOM view; holds no game rules |
| tooling | `scripts/validate.ts`, `scripts/routes.ts`, `scripts/browser-smoke.ts` | Content gate: grammar, pacing, reachability by playing the real engine |

Checks on 2026-10-27 after commit 94a21fe: `bun run validate` OK (Foundation 9.47 / 10.73 min on the direct routes, ridge waystation 15.90–20.17 min after Foundation, 122/122 reachable); `bun run typecheck` clean; `bun test` 97/97; `bun run smoke` passes.

## Non-obvious facts (verify before changing)

- Derived fields (`max`, `rate`, `open`, `length`, `yield`, `discount`) are never saved; `recompute` rebuilds them (fixed point, ≤8 passes) on every change and load (`src/types.ts:28-29`, `src/engine.ts:229-285`).
- `X.mod.Y` patches raise another record's payout table, including levels already earned (`src/engine.ts:56-77`). The ridge patches chapter one: Body Disciple patches Labour, Earth Listener Stone Sense, Formation Student the pallet, cot, mat and herb plot (`src/data/ridge.json:276-294`).
- Tempo comes from `length`: absent means instant, a number means timed, `"continuous"` means perpetual. One slot plus a waiting list of 6 that keeps running while away; the `autoStart` Rest fills idle time and fills both Vigor and Life (`src/engine.ts:6`, `src/engine.ts:782-822`, `src/engine.ts:869`).
- Chapter one has no sustained earners: `mill_shift` and `rack_tending` are gone. Coin and herbs trickle in through passive rates on the fifth sack and Shu's apprenticeship, which accrue while away. Wen's wage also raises `coin_earned.rate`, so it counts toward the directions' wages sign, and `ferry_hauling`'s `mod` cancels both rates once taken (`src/data/opening.json:7`, `src/data/opening.json:33`, `src/data/opening.json:53`, ADR 0022 amendments).
- Discoveries are logged and **never pause** activity; the validator rejects `pause` on events (`src/engine.ts:1411-1424`, `validateGrammar` in `scripts/validate.ts`, ADR 0027).
- A timed record's `lock` applies when its bill is first paid, not on completion; removed waiting entries and released methods are logged (`src/engine.ts:1283-1300`, ADR 0027). `warnText` asks while anything it locks is still open, and a content `warn` replaces the generated sentence, so it must name what closes.
- `g.t_<tag>` counts owned, unlocked records carrying the tag (a technique once used); a record id equal to a tag is a validation error. Key names live in `routeKeys` in `src/content.ts`, the ridge's direction signs read the school keys and `t_furnished` (cot, herb plot, strongbox), and a key carried but never read fails validation (`src/engine.ts:186-193`, `validateGrammar` and `validateContext` in `scripts/validate.ts`).
- No gate (`require`, `need`, breakthrough core or pointer, event `when`) in `opening.json` or `ridge.json` may name a record from the other chapter's file; `shared.json` is exempt (`validateModuleSeams`, `scripts/validate.ts:282`, ADR 0024).
- `g.<id>.attuned` is a read-only expression field, 1 while that method holds an attunement place; the validator allows it only on records with `attune`. Rest's Composure reads `g.settle_breath.attuned` (`src/engine.ts:207`, `scripts/validate.ts:99`, ADR 0023).
- Reveal order is array order in the JSON files (`src/engine.ts:97`).
- Any JSON field outside the vocabulary fails validation; removed fields are named (`recordFields` and `REMOVED_FIELDS` in `scripts/validate.ts`).
- Pacing is enforced by `bun run validate` (ADR 0028, about ten minutes of honest play): Foundation 480–780 s and Circulation by 600 s on the direct routes; preference routes within 1200 s; every timed action ≤180 s; every ridge route 720–1440 s from Foundation to the waystation, from either reading (`FOUNDATION_FLOOR` … `RIDGE_CEILING` in `scripts/validate.ts`). `scripts/routes.ts` enforces no band of its own.
- Save loading drops `items` for departed ids but refuses unknown ids in `attuned`, `active`, `waiting` and a saved `fight` (`src/persistence.ts:172-173`, `src/persistence.ts:113`, `src/persistence.ts:199`, `src/persistence.ts:219-223`).
- A fight is fixed by the stats and whole Life held when it starts, swings on Speed clocks during the run, cannot be stopped or replaced while undecided, and is saved mid-fight. Its projection is an exact win chance with graded verdicts (certain/likely/close/loss/hopeless) and a flip hint, and a finished fight survives the waiting list or Rest starting by themselves (`src/engine.ts:1084-1172`, `src/engine.ts:1760-1764`, `src/engine.ts:646-658`, ADR 0026).
- Older save versions are refused by name, not migrated (`src/persistence.ts:155-160`).
- One tab per profile (Web Locks); every action calls `settle()` before touching the engine (`src/main.ts:87-92`, `src/main.ts:160-161`).
- `src/ui.ts` names content ids directly (`home_space`, `jade_slip`, `vigor`…); renaming them breaks rendering, and `validate` will not notice (`src/ui.ts:45`, `src/ui.ts:907`).
- At ≤650 px the centre column is `display: contents`, so banners sit above the activity slot and Body panel and the tabbed activity panel follows; `#activities` (skip link and **Continue** target) is the activity panel, not `<main>` (`src/style.css:484`, `src/ui.ts:213`).
- The ridge chapter is implemented: four teachings, each with an attunable method carrying a school key, four exclusive First Directions with classes, crossings, the waystation and its four leads, and the optional bandit fight, whose cache the earth and formation teachings can trace without fighting (`cache_found`) (`src/data/ridge.json`, ADRs 0023, 0024, 0026).
- `playtest/SIMULATION-REPORT.md`'s current-pacing paragraph carries the 27 October `bun run validate` figures; its older sections are history. When they disagree, trust `bun run validate` output.

Lowbridge is a browser cultivation incremental (TypeScript, Bun, no runtime deps) inspired by *Arcanum: Theory of Magic*. Read this file first; it tells you which documents bind and which inform.

## Source of truth (binding, in this order)

1. `design/DESIGN-PLAN-2026-10-18.md` (incl. §0 clarifications) and `design/decisions/*.md` (ADRs).
2. `design/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN-2026-10-18.md`.
3. `README.md`: run/test commands, player-facing behaviour of the current slice.

When these disagree with the reference material below, **these win**. The reference describes the inspiration, not Lowbridge.

## Reference material (informative, MUST consult)

`research/arcanum-reference/README.md` is the design-reference wiki for the inspiration game: shell and layout, interaction semantics, data model, progression spine, skills, economy, home/domain, adventure/combat, spells, automation/time, a real T4 mid-game save, and numbered design rules (1–38, plus 70–74 under "G. Layer alignment", added 27 October 2026 from a craft critique of both references). It supersedes the two older studies in `research/` for anything they overlap on.

Before any of the following, read the matching page and cite the rule numbers (`12-design-rules.md`, e.g. "rule 4, 18") in your plan or ADR:

| Task | Read first |
|---|---|
| New or changed screen, tab, tooltip, button state, mobile layout | `01-shell-and-layout.md`, `02-interaction-semantics.md`, `screens/` |
| New content type, field, requirement expression, save-format change | `03-data-model.md` |
| Breakthroughs, classes, caps, locks, morality, pacing | `04-progression-spine.md`, `05-skills-and-education.md`, `11-midgame-snapshot-wizrobe.md` |
| Resources, caps, storage, home, furniture, converters | `06-economy-resources.md`, `07-home-and-domain.md` |
| Combat, sites, stress, spells, automation, offline time | `08-…`, `09-…`, `10-…` |
| Any hard number from the inspiration | `data-tables.md` (testing build 0.12.12.9) before `wiki-notes.md` (stable 0.12.0.0); say which version you used |
| The author's own wording of a mechanic | `glossary-verbatim.md` |

Rules in `12-design-rules.md` are tagged *copy* / *beat*. Diverging from a *copy* rule is allowed but MUST be stated explicitly with the reason, in the ADR or the PR description. Do not rediscover these facts from the live game or source; extend the wiki instead.

`research/hundred-days-reference/README.md` is the second reference: **Hundred Days / 筑基**, a Chinese cultivation idle game built on a fork of Arcanum's engine (live `P0.3.9c`, English branch). It is the nearest existing thing to Lowbridge, so consult it for anything cultivation-flavoured: a spendable lifespan (`02` §5, `04` §3), a cultivation tree over Arcanum's spine (`02` §2–4), the six-stage shape the community found (`05` §4), and the content-rot evidence for keeping `bun run validate` strict (`03` §7). Its rules are numbered 39–69 in `06-design-rules.md`, continuing Arcanum's 1–38; rules 70–74 in `12-design-rules.md` cover both games, so the numbered rules run 1–74. Cite them the same way ("rule 39, 51"). Arcanum stays the primary reference where the two overlap; Hundred Days is evidence of what one designer did with the same machine, not a template.

## Maintaining the reference

- `data-tables.md`, `save-wizrobe-analysis.json`, `section-texts.json`, `tooltips.json` are **generated**. Do not hand-edit; regenerate from `data-unstable-0.12.12.9.tar.gz` (unpack, load every `*.json`, index records by `id`) and the save, then replace the file.
- New findings go into the matching numbered page plus, if they change a rule, `12-design-rules.md`. Mark unmeasured claims `[INFERENCE]`.
- Keep version labels on every number (0.12.0.0 wiki / 0.12.3.1 pinned source / 0.12.12.9 testing).
- Screenshots live in `research/arcanum-reference/screens/`; name new ones `<section>.webp` or `tip-<kind>-<id>.webp`.
- The upstream source is MIT (`research/arcanum-study-2026-10-16/UPSTREAM-LICENSE`); Lowbridge is a clean implementation, never a fork. Do not copy upstream code or text into `src/`.
- `research/hundred-days-reference/data-census.md` is **generated** by `tools/census.py` from a checkout of `MaxRau/Hundred-days` (branch `english`); regenerate, never hand-edit. Version label there is `P0.3.9c`. The fork ships Arcanum's engine with **no licence and no MIT notice** (`04` §7); nothing from it may be copied into `src/` either.

## Working in this repo

- Commands: `bun run dev`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, `bun run validate`, `bun run validate:design`, `bun run build`, `bun run smoke` (see `README.md`).
- Content is data in `src/data/`; engine in `src/engine.ts`; UI in `src/ui.ts` + `src/style.css`; persistence in `src/persistence.ts`. Follow the existing record vocabulary before adding fields.
- Scope is the current slice: the village to Foundation, the ridge chapter to the waystation with its two optional fights, and chapter two, the basin road from the waystation to the Second Direction and Reedmarket (`design/CHAPTER-2-BASIN-ROAD.md`, ADRs 0030, 0031 and 0032): sphere technique pairs, one Direction per tier with derived titles, Focus, foe techniques, lasting draughts, the hobby place and two dungeons (ADR 0032). Reference systems beyond that (sects, waystation modules, the Hall) are evidence for later slices, not licence to add panels now.
- The DeepInit block above predates chapter two: the four exclusive directions and class `mod` tables it cites are gone (ADR 0030), content is 219 records in four files, saves are v7, and `bun run validate` also enforces the Second Direction and arrival bands and that every dungeon is cleared on some route. Trust the commands and the ADRs over the block until it is regenerated.
- `review/` is a frozen package; never modify it.
